mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (trade_no, order_id, user_id, amount, method, status, pay_time) VALUES (#{tradeNo}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{status}, #{payTime})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS user_name FROM payment p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
